description: The §53.8.1 Booking example (its declaration invariant over two `int` day-number fields) compiles and runs; its field refinement `number(>0 && <365)` is left out here — a struct field's refinement is the bootstrap's run-time-refinement INTERIM (g-boot-refinement-runtime-checks-s478).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §53.8.1 / §66.13.5: `invariant (checkIn < checkOut) [validDateRange]` on `type Booking:struct`; `<` takes numbers (ruled S440), so the fields are `int` day numbers.
